workshoptitle: Build an Ontology-Grounded F1 Rules Assistant with RDF Graph and AI Agents

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop overview, objectives, and what the sandbox sets up for you.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Load and Chunk the F1 Documents
tutorials.description: Load two PDFs with DBMS_CLOUD and split them into chunks with DBMS_VECTOR_CHAIN.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Extract Ontology-Aligned Facts with an LLM
tutorials.description: Extract JSON triples from every chunk with an ontology-constrained prompt.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Load and Query the RDF Graph
tutorials.description: Convert triples to RDF terms, bulk load F1_2026_GRAPH, and query it with SPARQL.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Create the Question and Change Agents
tutorials.description: Build a read-only question agent and a guarded change agent with DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Ask the Agents from the Chatbot
tutorials.description: Sign in to the APEX chatbot and ask the agent team questions and changes.

tutorials.title: Bonus Lab: Use OWL Inference to Classify a Hybrid Car
tutorials.description: Load the F1 ontology into the database and use OWL 2 RL inference to classify Car2026 as a HybridCar.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Template to link to Need Help lab at the end of workshop.
